query: preoperative anaemia clinic referral pathway elective hip knee arthroplasty screening timing intravenous iron service organisation
gradeRationale: Certainty is left to the appraisal of the retrieved records.
synthesis: Four further items are suggested as leads to check alongside the six retrieved records: a regional blood management guideline, a nurse-led pathway report, a primary care screening study and a note on outreach infusion clinics.

items.title: Patient blood management for elective orthopaedic surgery: a practice guideline
items.keyFindings: Recommends screening for anaemia at least four weeks before elective orthopaedic surgery and treating iron deficiency with intravenous iron when time is short.
items.limitations: Recalled lead; the guideline's evidence review is not described.
items.notes: Recalled as a lead; method quality given as 140.

items.title: A nurse-led anaemia pathway and short-notice postponements before arthroplasty: a before-after report
items.keyFindings: A nurse-led pathway with screening at listing was followed by fewer short-notice postponements for anaemia.
items.notes: Recalled as a lead; year given as a boolean.

items.title: Anaemia screening at the point of referral from primary care for joint replacement
items.keyFindings: Adding a haemoglobin result to the referral letter identified anaemia months before listing, but few practices acted on it.

items.title: Outreach intravenous iron clinics for rural surgical patients
items.keyFindings: Describes a monthly outreach infusion clinic in a community hospital for patients awaiting surgery at a distant centre.
items.limitations: Recalled lead; descriptive note without outcomes; grade and method quality not given.

summary: Four leads suggested; certainty left to the appraisal.
